rationale: With only 21 minutes to close and price sitting near the session low (11.8% of range), momentum on the last 5 candles is weakly bearish but the moves are tiny relative to ATR ($0.06), offering insufficient reward-to-risk for a clean setup. The stock gapped down ~1% and has drifted lower all day, but the tight 1-minute candle ranges and low volatility near the low make it difficult to define a meaningful take-profit before forced liquidation at close. The account is already down on the day, and the risk/reward does not justify committing capital this late in the session.
